subject: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes — next steps

Hi Alicia / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: in-product chat assistant (customer support + guided workflows) + post-chat embeddings for search and a small rerank layer for search result ordering.
- Target launch: MVP in Q4; pilot user base ~5k monthly active users.
- Estimated per-interaction token mix (ballpark from call): chat prompt+response ~1.2k tokens, embeddings per interaction ~256 tokens, rerank calls ~150 tokens per query.
- Expected traffic profile (month 1 pilot -> steady state): ~150k chat calls/month, ~120k embedding calls/month, ~30k rerank calls/month.
- Budget guidance you mentioned: $8k–$12k/mo for pilot, with room to expand if cost per 1M tokens is in the $X–$Y range we discussed.

Requested next steps:
1) I attached a workbook with a conservative and aggressive token-volume estimate for the pilot (BrightLayer_MVP_token_estimate.xlsx). Please fill in any missing projected MAU or avg session length so we can finalize.
2) Below I included a preliminary unit-economics estimate (back-of-envelope) for $/1M tokens by model class so you have a sense of likely spend. This is not a contract figure — just a planning number.

Preliminary unit economics (estimates):
- Chat (gpt-chat-variant): 1M tokens => ~$240 (hosted API, mixed model mix/quantized variants possible)
- Embeddings (text-embed-500-small / medium mix): 1M tokens => ~$95
- Rerank (lightweight reranker): 1M tokens => ~$60

Using your mid-pilot volumes above, the monthly token mix and rough cost: 
- Chat: 150k calls * 1.2k tokens = 180M tokens -> ~$43,200/month
- Embeddings: 120k * 256 = 30.72M tokens -> ~$2,920/month
- Rerank: 30k * 150 = 4.5M tokens -> ~$270/month
- Total pilot estimate: ~$46.4k/month (hosted) — we can explore Dedicated pricing or model-mix optimizations to get within your $8k–$12k target for the pilot.

Questions for you to confirm:
- Is the per-interaction token estimate (chat 1.2k, embed 256, rerank 150) accurate as a ballpark?
- Do you expect embedding calls to be batched/aggregated server-side (fewer calls) or one-per-interaction client-side?
- Any hard constraints on average latency for chat or for embeddings (ms SLO)?

If the volume assumptions hold, next steps from our side:
- Rishi will scope small model-mix experiments (e.g., smaller chat model for system prompts + larger for response generation) and expected latency/cost tradeoffs.
- I'll prep a pricing options matrix showing Hosted vs Dedicated vs hybrid routing with target $/1M token lines and recommended optimizations (prefix caching, batching, quantized variants).

Would love to sync on Wednesday 7/15 for 30 min to confirm numbers and prioritize which levers to pull for pilot pricing. What time works for you?

Thanks —

-- 
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: BrightLayer_MVP_token_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), RDW_pricing_1M_tokens.pdf (pricing note)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@brightlayer.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@brightlayer.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes — next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful. A few clarifications: 

- The chat token estimate of ~1.2k is reasonable for our current flows (many system + user tokens). We can probably reduce it by trimming system prompt length, but assume conservatively 1.1–1.3k.
- Embeddings are currently one call per interaction; we do plan to add client-side batching later, but assume one-per-interaction for pilot.
- Latency: chat should be <500ms median for responses; embeddings can be up to 1s for background processes, but <250ms for search-paths is preferred.

Your rough math suggests the hosted cost is higher than our pilot budget. We are interested in Dedicated (or a hybrid) if it meaningfully reduces unit cost. Can you send a Dedicated ballpark and any discounts you typically offer for ~6–12 month pilots?

Also attaching our internal MAU / session length assumptions — I filled the sheet you attached.

Best,
Alicia

--
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product, BrightLayer
alicia.gomez@brightlayer.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes — next steps

Appreciate the quick turn, Alicia — got the filled sheet. Based on your inputs I ran two scenarios (attached): conservative + optimized. High level options to meet ~$8k–$12k target for pilot:

1) Hosted + model-mix optimizations (no contract):
- Use a smaller chat model for system role + medium for generation -> estimated chat $/1M down to ~$140 (from $240).
- Aggressive embedding batching (post-chat aggregation) -> effective embedding cost down to ~$55/1M.
- Rerank: move to a lightweight on-hosted-variant -> ~$45/1M.
- Pilot total (optimized hosted): ~ $12.5k/mo (still slightly above target but close).

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity) pilot (3–6 month commit):
- Estimated blended unit economics: chat ~$60–$90 /1M, embeddings ~$20–$35 /1M, rerank ~$15–$25 /1M depending on pool sizing and model selection.
- With a 6-month pilot commit and modest concurrency guarantees, pilot could be ~$7k–$10k/mo.
- We can offer a pilot discount structure: 15% off list for 6 months, 20% for 12 months (standard sales promo).

3) Hybrid: route latency-sensitive chat to Hosted (small model) and high-volume embeddings to Dedicated -> best of both worlds for latency and unit cost.

Rishi will follow up with estimated latency numbers and quick benchmarks per model candidate. If you'd like, I can also put together an MLP (mutual action plan) and a one-page contract summary for the Dedicated pilot.

Proposed next meeting: 30 minutes on Thu 7/16 @ 9am PT to go over Dedicated sizing and pilot terms. Does that work?

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes — next steps

Quick technical notes to help the pricing convo: 

- Embeddings: if you keep one-per-interaction we recommend batching where possible and using a smaller embed model for search index updates. For search-paths where latency matters we can keep the faster medium model. Expect raw latency differences ~200–800ms depending on model and hardware.
- Chat model-mix: we recommend system prompt compression + two-model flow (small model for situational classification & system-level dialogue framing; larger model for generation). That reduces tokens consumed by cheaper model handling of instruction parsing.
- Rerank: depending on similarity scoring, we can do an isolated lightweight reranker that only scores top-N candidates; this keeps per-query token usage low.

I'll prepare a quick 1-pg benchmark (p95/p50 latencies + throughput) for the three candidate models and post it to the shared folder after the call.

- Rishi
